purpose: Freeze causally valid multi-timeframe, state, historical-neighbor, macro-vintage, and protective-barrier semantics before any historical payload, outcome, adapter, backtest, calibration, paper, or live activity.

time_contract.visibility_invariant: A bar is visible at decision_time if and only if is_closed is the exact JSON boolean true; source_timestamp, close_time, available_at, and decision_time are present, valid, timezone-aware, mutually comparable timestamps; and source_timestamp <= decision_time, close_time <= decision_time, and available_at <= decision_time. Any missing, malformed, incomparable timestamp or pseudo-boolean is_closed fails closed to DATA_INVALID and UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
time_contract.event_visibility_invariant: An event is visible at decision_time if and only if source_timestamp, published_at, available_at, and decision_time are present, valid, timezone-aware, mutually comparable timestamps; and source_timestamp <= decision_time, published_at <= decision_time, and available_at <= decision_time. source_timestamp records source provenance and is distinct from published_at, the public event publication time. Any missing, malformed, incomparable or future timestamp fails closed to DATA_INVALID and UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
time_contract.visibility_rule: A bar is visible at decision_time if and only if the full visibility_invariant holds.
time_contract.parent_visibility_rule: A child-timeframe decision may consume a parent TFState only from the latest parent bar satisfying the full visibility_invariant; an unclosed, late, future-sourced, malformed, missing, conflicting, or data-invalid parent bar is never substituted with a current estimate.
time_contract.same_timestamp_rule: If close_time equals decision_time, the bar is visible only when available_at also equals or precedes decision_time. source_sequence is comparable only within one (source_id,generation_id_or_stream_id). Cross-source records sharing available_at form an unordered batch with no economic before/after; exchangeable aggregation is batch-permutation invariant, while only a non-exchangeable result requiring first-hit must resolve UNRESOLVED or STOP_FIRST. stable_input_id is replay serialization only, never market-time order.
time_contract.record_identity_rule: source_sequence is comparable only within the same source_id and generation_id_or_stream_id. Missing, duplicate or conflicting source_sequence/stable_input_id/record_version or other required identity fails closed to DATA_INVALID and UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN; stable_input_id is replay serialization only.

state_contract.orthogonality_rule: DataQuality is a separate axis from StructuralRegime. A TFState has exactly one value from each named enum axis; DATA_INVALID is data_quality only and is never a StructuralRegime.
state_contract.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN means sufficient valid closed data does not exist for a declared axis measurement. It is not UP, DOWN, or RANGE by default.
state_contract.transition_rule: For DataQuality=VALID, TRANSITION is the remaining StructuralRegime cross-region or incomplete same-timeframe hysteresis. Parent-child conflict belongs only to DecisionState.parent_child_relation and never rewrites a TFState StructuralRegime.
state_contract.data_invalid_rule: DATA_INVALID means a required temporal, schema, sequence, duplicate, revision, or availability invariant failed. The decision must fail closed to UNKNOWN or ABSTAIN and may not coerce DATA_INVALID into a StructuralRegime.
state_contract.mapping_boundary: The mapping is an ontology crosswalk only. It freezes neither thresholds nor a predictive or trading interpretation; potential top/bottom never grants entry permission.

mechanical_label_mapping.UP_DECELERATION: 4h.StructuralRegime=UP + 1h.kinematics=DECELERATING + directional_efficiency and state_age retained as separate axes
mechanical_label_mapping.DOWN_DECELERATION: 4h.StructuralRegime=DOWN + 1h.kinematics=DECELERATING + directional_efficiency and state_age retained as separate axes
mechanical_label_mapping.rule: POTENTIAL_BOTTOMING and POTENTIAL_TOPPING are observable candidates, not confirmed bottoms/tops or entry permissions. BREAKOUT_RISK defaults to ABSTAIN until an independently validated continuation branch exists.

parent_child_contract.read_rule: Each child may read only its adjacent visible parent TFState; no skipped-parent override or weighted vote is permitted.
parent_child_contract.authority_rule: Only 4h may set operational structural_regime; 1w and 1d may veto risk but cannot create entry; 1h and 15m cannot overwrite the 4h structural_regime.
parent_child_contract.conflict_rule: Parent conflict, parent UNKNOWN, or DATA_INVALID cannot be resolved by child voting and must produce UNKNOWN or ABSTAIN; it is recorded in DecisionState.parent_child_relation and never rewrites either TFState StructuralRegime.

MarketScenario.label_definition: For a frozen horizon H, frozen barriers B_up/B_down and frozen central_range_band defined before outcome access: UPSIDE/DOWNSIDE require a sortable valid event stream and respectively upper/lower barrier first; RANGE requires neither barrier by H plus terminal displacement and realized range inside central_range_band; UNRESOLVED is valid data with neither-first but failing RANGE, or both barriers in the same window without sequence proof. These four classes are mutually exclusive and exhaustive for valid data; UNKNOWN/DATA_INVALID are model/data-invalid outputs outside normalization.
MarketScenario.probability_scalar_rule: Every probability is a finite JSON number in [0,1]. JSON booleans true/false are not probability numbers and must fail closed.
MarketScenario.unknown_output_boundary: UNKNOWN is a model/data-invalid output and not a MarketScenario class; it never participates in normalization.
MarketScenario.normalization_rule: Exactly the four MarketScenario branches are mutually exclusive and sum to one within a declared pre-event horizon; insufficient support, invalid probability, or missing calibration returns UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
MarketScenario.decision_rule: A MarketScenario probability is a calibrated candidate output only; it cannot directly create an order or override the action priority.

ActionOutcome.conditional_scope: Per declared candidate action conditional on valid submission; NO_FILL is a mutually exclusive terminal outcome of the submission attempt and the vector is not conditional-on-fill.
ActionOutcome.probability_scalar_rule: Every probability is a finite JSON number in [0,1]. JSON booleans true/false are not probability numbers and must fail closed.
ActionOutcome.normalization_rule: Exactly the five ActionOutcome branches are mutually exclusive and sum to one; insufficient support, invalid probability, or unproven submission/outcome cohort returns UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
ActionOutcome.fill_and_conditional_distribution: P(fill)=1-P(NO_FILL). For filled-cohort outcomes, renormalize TP_FIRST/SL_FIRST/STRUCTURE_EXIT/TIMEOUT by their joint-probability sum; never include NO_FILL in the conditional-on-fill distribution.
ActionOutcome.data_disposition: DataDisposition={VALID,CENSORED,DATA_INVALID,OPERATIONAL_OVERRIDE} is outside the ActionOutcome probability vector. Invalid data, censoring or post-fill operational/risk override fails closed and is counted rather than silently deleted.
ActionOutcome.post_fill_scoring_semantics: At submission freeze immutable five-branch prediction. Store observed_fill=true|false|null, observed_action_outcome=one_of_five_branches|null and DataDisposition separately. Score P(fill) only where observed_fill is non-null; joint only where one terminal outcome is known; filled-cohort only where observed_fill=true and terminal outcome is known. CENSORED/DATA_INVALID/OPERATIONAL_OVERRIDE never rewrite prediction or fabricate NO_FILL/terminal outcome; each affected score excludes only its missing label while disposition and pre/post-fill counts remain reported.
ActionOutcome.strict_record_validation: One shared validator runs before every denominator/count: observed_fill has exact JSON type boolean or null, so numeric pseudo-booleans 1/0/1.0/0.0 are rejected; observed_action_outcome has exact JSON type string and is one of NO_FILL/TP_FIRST/SL_FIRST/STRUCTURE_EXIT/TIMEOUT, or is null; NO_FILL requires observed_fill=false; a filled terminal requires observed_fill=true; unknown labels or contradictions are DATA_INVALID and never counted.
ActionOutcome.decision_rule: An ActionOutcome probability cannot directly create an order, change a cohort, broaden a stop, or extend a horizon.

current_pressure_contract.required_quality_rule: Every required TFState and required CurrentPressureContext field family must have DataQuality=VALID. STALE, GAP, CONFLICT, DATA_INVALID, UNKNOWN, missing time proof, or missing required field forces UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN and cannot produce EVALUATE_REVERSAL or EXECUTION_READY.

causal_measurement_contract.returns: r_t = log(close_t / close_{t-1}) for eligible closed bars only.
causal_measurement_contract.atr_scale: ATR_n(t) = causal ATR over the last n eligible closed bars; realized_vol_n(t) = sqrt(sum_{i=t-n+1}^t r_i^2). scale_t = max(ATR_n(t), close_t * realized_vol_n(t), epsilon).
causal_measurement_contract.directional_efficiency: de_n(t) = abs(close_t - close_{t-n}) / max(sum_{i=t-n+1}^t abs(close_i-close_{i-1}), epsilon).
causal_measurement_contract.non_overlapping_acceleration: a_n(t) = v_n(t) - v_n(t-n); the two velocity windows must not overlap. kinematics is ACCELERATING/STEADY/DECELERATING only by a frozen sign/threshold rule.
causal_measurement_contract.trailing_location: loc_t = (close_t - z_low) / max(z_high-z_low, epsilon) for frozen causal StructuralZone=[z_low,z_high], with a separately frozen extension band expressed in scale_t.

structural_regime_boolean.UP: v_n(t) >= theta_v AND de_n(t) >= theta_de AND this_timeframe_hysteresis_complete
structural_regime_boolean.DOWN: v_n(t) <= -theta_v AND de_n(t) >= theta_de AND this_timeframe_hysteresis_complete
structural_regime_boolean.RANGE: -theta_v < v_n(t) < theta_v AND de_n(t) < theta_de AND this_timeframe_hysteresis_complete
structural_regime_boolean.TRANSITION: DataQuality=VALID AND ((the remaining cross-region, including de_n >= theta_de with -theta_v < v_n < theta_v) OR this_timeframe_hysteresis_incomplete). Parent-child conflict belongs only to DecisionState.parent_child_relation and never rewrites a TFState regime.
structural_regime_boolean.UNKNOWN: candidate family is unfrozen, any required field/time proof is absent, or DataQuality is not VALID

causal_measurement_contract.parameter_domain: theta_v must be finite and >0; theta_de must be finite and 0<=theta_de<=1; normalized_velocity must be finite; directional_efficiency is finite and in [0,1]; n, hysteresis_length h and volatility_window are positive integers; epsilon is finite and >0; all bands/scales must be finite, ordered and nonnegative where applicable.
causal_measurement_contract.invalid_domain_rule: Any parameter-domain violation produces DATA_INVALID/UNKNOWN and StructuralRegime is not computed.

candidate_tuple_contract.band_rule: extension_band and central_range_band are finite nonnegative [lower,upper] pairs with lower<=upper; all scale-like values are finite and nonnegative.
candidate_tuple_contract.family_rule: Family length is 1..8, every tuple is exact-key complete and semantically unique after numeric normalization, and every tuple satisfies the full parameter and enum domain before any outcome access. Numerically equal encodings such as 1 versus 1.0 and -0.0 versus 0.0 are duplicates.

causal_measurement_contract.finite_candidate_family: Before any outcome access, choose at most eight complete valid tuples (n, theta_v, theta_de, extension_band, hysteresis_length, volatility_window, ATR_or_RV_choice, volume_baseline_method, weekday_or_session_adjustment, central_range_band, epsilon). No infinite/grid expansion, online update, result-conditioned replacement or parameter blending is permitted.
causal_measurement_contract.freeze_rule: If no complete pre-outcome candidate tuple is frozen, all measurement-dependent outputs are UNKNOWN.

h10_daily_prefix_contract.prefix_rule: At prefix Dk, the measurement state, probability, and action may read only D1..Dk fields satisfying the full visibility_invariant at the prefix decision_time. D(k+1)..D8 are forbidden input and may not rewrite the earlier prefix record.

specific_prefix_assertions.D2_D3_price_primary: H10 may evaluate only observed D1..D2 or D1..D3 prefixes for the predeclared 1-3 day UPWARD_EXPANSION price endpoint after each prefix available_at; it may not select the full D1..D8 episode and no event arrival may enter this price endpoint.
specific_prefix_assertions.D6_D7_price_primary: H11 may evaluate only observed D1..D6 or D1..D7 prefixes for the predeclared next-day DOWNSIDE_BREAKDOWN price endpoint after each prefix available_at; it may not select the full D1..D8 episode and no event arrival may enter this price endpoint.
specific_prefix_assertions.H12_event_diagnostic: H12 event arrival association is a separate diagnostic only after the full event_visibility_invariant holds. It cannot make either H10 or H11 price endpoint pass.

h10_daily_prefix_contract.cluster_rule: All D1..D8 nested prefixes from one anchor are one episode cluster for split, bootstrap, and multiple-comparison accounting; they are not eight independent observations.
h10_daily_prefix_contract.event_rule: A message/event is readable only when the full event_visibility_invariant holds: source_timestamp, published_at and available_at are each no later than the prefix decision time. source_timestamp is source provenance and is distinct from published_at, the public event publication time. A later revision is append-only and cannot overwrite an earlier prefix. Event availability is diagnostic only and never a H10/H11 price-endpoint disjunct.
h10_daily_prefix_contract.volume_rule: Use log-volume residual against either a robust trailing median/MAD baseline or a frozen EWMA baseline, selected only within the at-most-eight causal candidate tuples. A baseline may use only prior eligible observations and its frozen weekday/session adjustment.
h10_daily_prefix_contract.pool_boundary: Any mismatch in asset_class, venue, market_type, instrument_id, contract_specification, session_timezone, daily_boundary, volume_unit or price_adjustment_policy must not pool into one cohort; use a separately registered stratum or fail DATA_INVALID. Equity and crypto observations must never be pooled as one calibration or baseline cohort.
h10_daily_prefix_contract.unknown_action_rule: UNKNOWN is permitted only for invalid, missing or unfrozen required inputs; valid evaluated states use OBSERVE, ABSTAIN or EVALUATE_REVERSAL.
h10_daily_prefix_contract.action_boundary: Each prefix action uses exactly UNKNOWN, OBSERVE, ABSTAIN, or EVALUATE_REVERSAL until a separately authorized execution contract exists. A large event bar cannot be chased into EXECUTION_READY, and an exit or invalidation cannot automatically reverse direction in the same episode.
h10_daily_prefix_contract.nonvalid_block: Any non-VALID required data quality, missing or conflicting source_sequence where an ordering is required within the same source_id and generation_id_or_stream_id, missing, malformed, incomparable or future event source_timestamp/published_at/available_at, missing volume baseline, or unfrozen candidate tuple forces UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN. Cross-source equal-available_at batches are not invalid merely because they have no economic order.

episode_lifecycle.identity_and_eligibility: episode_id and immutable creation record identify existence. active is lifecycle persistence; eligible_for_upgrade=false at creation and on the same bar, and becomes true only for a strictly later eligible closed bar after every upgrade gate passes.
episode_lifecycle.new_observe_emitted: Boolean separate from Action: true exactly once only when cross_valid, VALID quality, valid parent, candidate gates pass and nonterminal create an episode; persistent extreme keeps it false.
episode_lifecycle.creation: Invalid-data, invalid-parent, failed-gate or terminal cross creates no episode; only a fully valid cross creates episode_id with Action=OBSERVE and new_observe_emitted=true.
episode_lifecycle.dedup: Persistent extreme does not create a second OBSERVE or episode.
episode_lifecycle.upgrade: Only later eligible closed time with active=true, eligible_for_upgrade=true, unexpired episode, VALID quality, valid parent relation, all candidate gates and no terminal action may produce EVALUATE_REVERSAL; same-bar upgrade is forbidden.
episode_lifecycle.termination: Frozen expiry, data-quality failure, parent invalidation or terminal action retains immutable episode identity but sets active=false and eligible_for_upgrade=false. An existing inactive record without termination proof returns UNKNOWN with LIFECYCLE_PROOF_MISSING; other missing lifecycle proof fails closed to ABSTAIN.

historical_neighbor_contract.causal_eligibility_rule: A neighbor is eligible only when its feature_version matches the query, its data_validity is VALID, and label_tail_end plus embargo is strictly earlier than query_available_at.
historical_neighbor_contract.market_claim_boundary: Similarity is a retrieval candidate, not evidence that a historical path will recur.

macro_contract.join_rule: At decision_time, use only the latest macro record whose actual_release_at and vintage_available_at are both at or before decision_time.
macro_contract.first_release_rule: The first released vintage is immutable as a point-in-time record; later revisions are appended with a distinct vintage_id and never overwrite it.
macro_contract.scheduled_vs_actual_rule: scheduled_release_at may define a risk window but may not expose a value before actual_release_at.
macro_contract.forbidden_interpretation: Macro events and disclosures may not be pre-labeled bullish or bearish in this measurement contract.

entry_zone_contract.state_permission_gate: StatePermissionGate={ALLOW,DENY} has no price coordinate. UNKNOWN/invalid data fails before the gate to UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN; ALLOW permits, but cannot move, StructuralZone intersect LiquidityFeasibleZone intersect RiskGeometryZone intersect VenueRuleZone; DENY produces empty EntryZone and ABSTAIN; any other gate is rejected.
entry_zone_contract.intersection_rule: An EntryZone exists only if StatePermissionGate=ALLOW and all four declared component zones are valid, visible, and their closed interval intersection is non-empty.
entry_zone_contract.forbidden_interpretation: A non-empty EntryZone is not an order, a direction, or a profitability claim.

protective_barrier_contract.stop_rule: After a hypothetical position exists, an updated stop may preserve or reduce worst-case price risk only; it may never broaden risk relative to the prior valid stop.
protective_barrier_contract.horizon_rule: An updated horizon_end may preserve or shorten the prior horizon only; it may never extend it.
protective_barrier_contract.target_rule: Initial target semantics and every permitted update category must be declared before evaluation. A target update may not be selected after observing the later barrier outcome, and this contract declares no target formula or order behavior.
protective_barrier_contract.intrabar_order_rule: If a bar or synthetic interval can touch both stop and target without an independently ordered event stream, classify it STOP_FIRST.
protective_barrier_contract.scope_boundary: This contract defines measurement and protective invariants, not an execution, fill, sizing, leverage, or profit model.

deterministic_replay_contract.ordering_rule: source_sequence is comparable only inside one (source_id,generation_id_or_stream_id). Cross-source equal-available_at records are an unordered economic batch: exchangeable aggregation must be batch-permutation invariant; only a non-exchangeable result requiring first-hit resolves UNRESOLVED or STOP_FIRST. A stable input_id tie-break is permitted only for canonical replay serialization, never to create market-time order.
deterministic_replay_contract.replay_rule: The same canonical inputs and versions must yield byte-equivalent canonical JSON output, including state, qualifiers, visibility disposition, and failure disposition.
deterministic_replay_contract.revision_rule: A revised input receives a new version and must produce a distinct replay identity; it must not silently replace the prior replay.
